answer: The juniper graph is validated at intake and the anchor frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and comet anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 5 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Duplicating the work 191 times multiplies the fee by 171 and leaves every copy exposed to a single slash, so the downside scales faster than the headcount. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
